description: We are a team of students excited to join the NASA Space Apps Challenge to gain new experiences, learn new skills, and explore opportunities in technology and space science. We want to challenge ourselves, improve our knowledge, and learn from others while working together to solve real-world problems. We may still be learning, but we are willing to try new things, share ideas, and grow through this experience.
summary:
Sojourner and the Little Red World is an interactive, child-friendly storybook about NASA's Mars Pathfinder mission and its Sojourner rover. Told through an imagined first-person voice, the story follows the rover from its launch in 1996 to its exploration of Ares Vallis on Mars in 1997.

The project brings mission history to life through an illustrated, chapter-based experience while distinguishing the fictional narration from historical mission facts. It is designed to make space exploration approachable for young readers and anyone curious about Mars.
details: Sojourner and the Little Red World is an interactive, chapter-based digital storybook that transforms NASA’s 1996–1997 Mars Pathfinder mission into a playful, first-person adventure narrated by the Sojourner rover itself as it launches from Earth and explores Ares Vallis on Mars. By translating dense planetary science and engineering jargon into simple, relatable storytelling while clearly distinguishing fictional narration from verified historical facts, the project makes space history accessible, engaging, and easy for young readers to grasp. Its intended impact is to demystify scientific concepts and spark early curiosity in STEM and space exploration for children, families, and educators. Developed using modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript), NASA mission archives, and hosted on Vercel, the project creatively blends character-driven storytelling and illustration with historical accuracy—carefully considering age-appropriate vocabulary, intuitive navigation, and clear boundaries between imagination and real-world data.
